t:
The staff were really welcoming and funny. The room was okay (private room with two beds).

It had two windows which is good for airflow but in the morning the streets were so loud even after I closed both windows and I couldn't get back to sleep.

The toilets smell HORRIBLE like you can't even stay for a few seconds there without holding your breath (edit: ink the morning it was cleaned and smelled good, increased by one star)

Good experience.
آطينا نيميرو تاع التي التيليفون خويا مهتمين بلحجز

This hostel is convenient if you are travelling with someone and are on a small budget. The price is cheap compared to other options.

However, the stairs did not feel very safe, and the shared bathrooms are quite small. The beds were covered with plastic, which made them uncomfortable. When I asked the staff if it could be removed, I was told it had to stay.

The staff were okay, but overall the comfort level was low.

I would only recommend this place if you are really on a tight budget and have limited options.
حطولنا رقم الهاتف من فضلكم رانا مهتمين بالحجز
